question: What youthful form results from constant yogic practice over sixteen years?
premises: Constant practice is joined with yoga
The duration indicated is sixteen years
inference: Through constant yogic practice one may attain the form of a sixteen-year-old.
uncertainties: dvi-aṣṭa-varṣa-ākṛtiḥ is taken as the form of sixteen years of age.
plain_english: Through constant yogic practice, one may attain the form of a sixteen-year-old.
